thread:
alex: quick heads-up — I'm planning a lightweight canary for the routing change today 21:00 UTC. 10% -> 25% -> 50% over ~40m. Who can own smoke and rollback readiness?
maya: I can own smoke checks and perf metrics. I'll run the smoke script and watch p95 and error-rate.
ryan: I'll be the deployer. Target window 21:00-21:45 UTC. Will push canary tag and start ramp. Will post rollout commands.
alex: thanks. Cohorts: na-west (5%), eu-central (3%), us-east (2%) to make 10% first wave. Then expand by region. Keep low-latency cohort only.
emily: for smoke checklist: 1) /health 2) simple chat generation end-to-end 3) tail logs for errors 4) check cache hit % 5) check 429s. I can run the end-to-end prompt suite.
maya: +1. Add quick synthetic load with the local runner: ./scripts/smoke_runner --profile quick
ryan: deploy steps:
```
deploy canary routing:v2 --cohorts=na-west:5,eu-central:3,us-east:2 --start
# wait for 10m
deploy canary routing:v2 --ramp=25 --wait=10m
deploy canary routing:v2 --ramp=50 --wait=20m
```
alex: rollback plan: immediate `deploy routing:previous --force`, and circuit-breaker to 0% via console. On-call Jordan will approve after 2 consecutive metric breaches.
jordan: I'm on-call and ready. Set alert thresholds: error-rate >0.5% or p95 latency +50% baseline for 5m -> page me. I'll be monitoring.
deploy-bot: deploy started by ryan at 1719003000 for routing:v2 -> canary cohorts: na-west 5%, eu-central 3%, us-east 2%
ryan: first wave started. maya, emily ping me if smoke fails.
maya: smoke done — health OK, samples look good, no errors. p95 baseline +10%.
emily: end-to-end tests passed, cache hit 78%, no 429s in logs.
ryan: ramping to 25% now.
deploy-bot: ramp to 25% completed at 1719003600
jordan: watching metrics — p95 drifting up 12% but below threshold. no pages.
maya: will run perf check at 21:25 UTC (10m into ramp).
ryan: if we stay green, next ramp to 50% at ~21:35 UTC.
alex: sounds good. tag final if stable and leave rollback window open for 60m after 50% ramp.
emily: noted. I'll run the regression prompt set after 50% and post results.
ryan: thanks everyone. will post final status around 22:15 UTC.
